short_answer: Paul Bovi is a real, long time Las Vegas handicapper. VegasInsider lists him as one of its experts, and on 17 Nov 2026 its picks page showed a premium college football pick from him for a game that day. You cannot buy Bovi on his own there: his picks come with VegasInsider Premium, which includes all of the site's experts.

His current record is public in one narrow way. VegasInsider grades its experts on one unit per pick, and on 17 Nov 2026 it showed Bovi at "96-94 This Year". That is 50.5% winners by our count, below the roughly 52.4% needed to break even at standard -110 odds. He was not among the leaders on the site's season boards for all sports, the NFL, college football or the NBA.

His bio leans on older results: a 15th place finish in the 2010 Hilton SuperContest, a 2020 to 2021 NFL ranking on VegasInsider, and Circa Million finishes. We found no buyer reviews of him, good or bad. Treat him as an experienced bettor whose current graded record is close to even, not a proven winner.
pricing_intro: Bovi has no separate price. His VegasInsider profile offers an "Auto renew VIP yearly Subscription" with "All picks from Paul Bovi and our other VI experts" and a "Try for $4.99" button. The plans below were on the VegasInsider Premium page on 17 Nov 2026.
pricing: Rolls into the monthly plan unless cancelled

guarantee: There is no guarantee. The VegasInsider refund policy says: "There is a no refund policy on Vegas Insider Premium monthly or annual subscriptions." It adds: "There are no performance guarantees on the VIP subscription and refunds will not be provided due to poor predictive performance." The only refunds it describes are for unauthorized or fraudulent card charges, reviewed case by case, though it ends by inviting customers who feel entitled to a refund to get in touch.

Plans renew on their own. The Why Buy Our Picks page says "all subscriptions will be automatically billed at the end of your product, either monthly or annually," and the 3 Day Pass continues at $19.99 per month. Losses on the bets themselves are never covered.

claims_note: The profile's record section highlights results from 2010, 2020 to 2022 and "the last decade", but not the current year. The current figure appears on the picks page instead: 96-94. We worked out what that means. At one $100 unit per pick, and if every pick were at -110, 96 wins and 94 losses would come to about $740 down. Picks are often at other prices, so the real figure will differ, but a 50.5% hit rate is below break even at normal prices.

The Circa Million detail does not match between two pages. VegasInsider says he finished 20th overall in 2020; VSiN's list of the 2025 Circa Friday Football Invitational field says "Top 20 finish in Circa Million (2019)". We could not open the Circa standings to settle it.
The 2010 SuperContest record of 51-33-1 would be a strong result if confirmed, but it is sixteen years old and we did not find a copy of the official standings.
record: What a buyer can check without paying: VegasInsider's own grading. The picks page showed "Paul Bovi 96-94 This Year" on 17 Nov 2026. On the season leaderboards we opened on 17 Nov 2026 (all sports, NFL, college football and NBA), Bovi was not among the listed profit or percentage leaders.

Contest results: VSiN's 2025 contest field list described him as a 2024 Circa Friday Football Invitational "elite eight" finisher. Midway through the 2025 edition, standings reposted on TheRX on 18 Oct 2025 showed him at 18-24-0 (42.9%), 17th by points. We did not find his final 2025 position. He was not among the names on VSiN's 2026 field page when we opened it.
What we could not check: the 2010 SuperContest finish, the Circa Million results, and the 73% Super Bowl prop claim. We found no court or regulator record about him.

customers_intro: We found no independent posts from people who paid for Paul Bovi's picks. What exists online is media work, contest standings and old interviews. Below is what we checked.

customers.text: We found no buyer review of Paul Bovi on any site or in any year we could search, neither praise nor complaint. That may be because he is sold only inside the VegasInsider subscription, so buyers who post about it talk about VegasInsider rather than about him. Forum mentions we found only repost his contest picks and standings, and press coverage from 2009 and 2020 shows him as an interviewed handicapper, not as the subject of complaints. With no posts either way there is no smoke to report. Our Reddit search was partial: the Reddit archive's full text search timed out on 17 Nov 2026, so we checked our saved copy of ten betting subreddits instead, and none mentioned him.

A TheRX member reposted the 2025 Circa Friday Football Invitational standings with each entrant's picks. Bovi was listed at 18-24-0 with 19.5 points, 17th. This is a contest record, not a buyer review.

A TheRX member posted the week one contest picks of each Circa Friday Football Invitational entrant, including Bovi's best bet on the Ravens. It shows his contest picks are public each week, which lets anyone follow his contest record.

Web searches of Covers, Sportsbook Review, TheRX and news sites found no buyer review, refund complaint or results thread about Paul Bovi or PanoramaSports.com, the website named for him in a 2009 interview. Our library of harvested buyer posts had no mention of him.

checklist: Open the VegasInsider picks page and note his current record before you pay. Check it again after a month.
If you take the $4.99 pass, set a reminder to cancel before it rolls into $19.99 a month.
Ask for his full pick history with odds, not only the win loss count. A 50% hit rate can win or lose depending on the prices.
Look up his contest picks and standings, which are public, and compare them with what he sells.
Record every pick yourself the moment you get it, with the line you can actually bet.
faq: He is a real Las Vegas handicapper, listed as an expert by VegasInsider, a long running site owned by Better Collective USA, Inc. His picks were live on 17 Nov 2026. What is not proven is that they win: the site showed him at 96-94 this year, and we found no court or regulator action involving him.
How much does Paul Bovi cost?
His picks come only with VegasInsider Premium. On 17 Nov 2026 that was $4.99 for a 3 day pass, then $19.99 a month, or $119.99 billed annually. Each plan includes every VegasInsider expert.
Does Paul Bovi have a verified record?

Partly. VegasInsider grades its experts at one unit per pick and showed him at 96-94 this year, which is 50.5%. That grading is done by the selling site. His older contest results, such as 51-33-1 in the 2010 SuperContest, are claims we could not check.
Is there a refund or guarantee?
No. VegasInsider's refund policy says there are no refunds on monthly or annual subscriptions and no refunds for poor predictive performance. Plans renew automatically.
What do buyers say about Paul Bovi?
We found nothing. No buyer review or complaint about him turned up on forums, review sites or in the news. Forum mentions only repost his contest picks and standings.

At $4.99 for three days the cost of trying is low, but his current graded record is about even and below break even at normal odds. If you subscribe, track his picks yourself, compare them with his public contest record, and cancel before the plan renews if you are not convinced.
